blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Neural networks are increasingly studied not merely as predictive systems, but as complex systems whose internal computations are themselves objects of scientific inquiry. Recent progress in mechanistic interpretability (MI) has made it possible to identify neurons, features, circuits, population structures, and dynamical patterns associated with model behavior. As these tools improve, attention is shifting from what can be observed inside a model to how those observations support mechanistic explanations. We examine the parallel efforts of neuroscience and MI to address this question and identify recurring inferential bottlenecks when inferring mechanisms from complex neural systems. We propose five principles and organize them into a recursive logic for a more rigorous procedure of mechanistic inference. These principles provide a framework that supports scientific discovery in two senses: it helps turn local interpretability findings into cumulative knowledge of mechanisms within models, and it makes those mechanisms sufficiently precise to generate testable hypotheses about domains beyond the models. Evidence beyond MI is ultimately required to establish what model mechanisms reveal about the world.
blocks.zh: 神经网络不仅被越来越多地研究为预测系统,而且被研究为复杂的系统,其内部计算本身就是科学调查的对象. 最近在机械解释性(MI)上的进展使得能够识别神经元,特征,电路,人口结构,以及与模型行为相关的动态规律. 随着这些工具的改进,注意力正在从一个模型内可观察到的东西转移到这些观测如何支持机械解释。 我们审查了神经科学和MI为解决这一问题而作的平行努力,并在从复杂的神经系统推断机制时,找出反复出现的暗示瓶颈。 我们提出五项原则,把它们组织成一种递归逻辑,以便更严格的机械推论程序。 这些原则提供了一个框架,从两个意义上支持科学发现:它有助于将局部可解释性发现转化为模型内机制的累积知识,并且使这些机制足够精确,可以产生模型外域的可验证假设. 归根结底,除了管理信息系统之外,还需要有其他证据,才能确定模式机制揭示出的世界。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) research for artificial neural networks (ANNs) has generated remarkable advances in new methodologies over the past decades. These techniques are increasingly used to study internal representations and computations. However, the success of these observational tools has made the gap between seeing a feature and understanding the computation larger and more subtle. In earlier studies, researchers were tempted to conclude from probing that information is recoverable from a representation without showing that the model actually uses that information in its computations. Likewise, interventions have been used to establish that a component is causally relevant without identifying the computational role that component plays ( Sharkey et al., 2025 ) . Recent works have attempted to address these concerns through high-level conceptual frameworks ( Vilas et al., 2024 ) or localized practices ( Geiger et al., 2025 ; Joshi et al., 2026 ) , but a general logic for moving from interpretability results to formal mechanistic claims remains missing.
blocks.zh: 人工神经网络(ANNs)的机械可解释性(MI)研究在过去几十年中在新方法方面取得了显著进展. 这些技术被越来越多地用于研究内部的表示和计算. 然而,这些观测工具的成功使得看到一个特征和理解计算之间的差距更大而更微妙. 在早先的研究中,研究人员试图通过探究信息从一种表述中可被取回而不表明模型在计算中实际使用该信息而得出结论。 同样,还使用了干预措施来确定某一组成部分因果相关而未确定该组成部分的计算作用(Sharkey等人,2025年)。 最近的工作试图通过高级别的概念框架(Vilas等,2024年)或地方做法(Geiger等,2025年;Joshi等,2026年)来解决这些问题,但从可解释性结果转向正式机械性索赔的一般逻辑仍然缺失。

blocks.en: We address this gap by examining the parallel efforts of neuroscientists to understand the brain and MI researchers to understand ANNs. Neuroscience has repeatedly confronted the same problem about what can be inferred from different kinds of observations about a neural system. Over decades, broad questions about neural mechanisms were factorized into more precise questions that separate what a component represents from how information is organized across populations, transformed over stages, picked up by downstream neurons, and preserved across different implementations ( Pouget et al., 2000 ; Quian Quiroga and Panzeri, 2009 ; Kriegeskorte and Douglas, 2019 ; Diedrichsen and Kriegeskorte, 2017 ) . This thinking revealed a fundamental inferential bottleneck of connecting one class of evidence to the next when dissecting complex neural systems. We coalesce these insights into five principles for ‘mechanistic’ inference. They concern identifying the appropriate explanatory object (P1), determining whether represented information is used in computation (P2), broadening from causal relevance to causal role (P3), moving from component role to organization (P4), and testing the invariance among levels of analysis and opening up new mechanistic questions (P5). Measurement conditions each of these inferences (P0).
blocks.zh: 我们通过研究神经科学家理解大脑的并行努力和理解ANNs的MI研究人员,来弥补这一差距. 神经科学反复地遇到同样的问题,从对神经系统的各种不同观察中可以推断出什么. 数十年来,关于神经机理的广泛问题被分解为更精确的问题,将一个要素与信息如何在人群中组织、分阶段转变、由下游神经元取而代之,并保存在不同实施过程中(Pouget等,2000年;Quian Quiroga和Panzeri,2009年;Kriegeskorte和Douglas,2019年;Diedrichsen和Kriegeskorte,2017年)。 这种思维揭示出一个根本的隐含瓶颈,即在解剖复杂的神经系统时将一类证据连接到下一类证据. 我们把这些见解结合到五项原则中, 它们涉及确定适当的解释性目标(P1),确定在计算中是否使用了代表信息(P2),从因果关系扩大到因果作用(P3),从组成部分作用转向组织作用(P4),并测试分析层次的不一致性并开启新的机械问题(P5)。 每种推论的测量条件(P0).

blocks.en: Our principles support MI as a science of discovery in two related senses. First, when neural networks are the object of study, the principles provide a recursive logic for turning local interpretability findings into more constrained and cumulative accounts of model mechanisms. Second, models trained on scientific data can be analyzed mechanistically to produce knowledge beyond themselves. Our framework explains how MI can identify precise candidate mechanisms, which can serve as sources of precise hypotheses and discriminating predictions about that domain.
blocks.zh: 我们的原则支持军情调查作为两个相关意义上的发现科学. 第一,当神经网络成为研究对象时,原理提供了将局部可解释性结论转化为模型机制更受制约和累积的描述的递归逻辑. 第二,可以对科学数据方面训练有素的模型进行机械分析,以产生更多的知识。 我们的框架解释了管理部如何能够确定确切的候选机制,这些机制可以作为该领域准确假设和歧视性预测的来源。

blocks.en: Figure 1: A recursive logic for mechanistic inference. For a given neural system with behavior of interest, it can be investigated by different candidate objects of study: neurons, features, circuits, population geometry, and dynamics. We propose five principles to organize mechanistic research as a recursive process in which evidence informs further questions and revisions to earlier claims. An individual study may address a subset of these questions and revisit them as needed. Red arrows connect these five inferential questions: which object explains the phenomenon (P1), whether represented information is used in computation (P2), what computational role it plays (P3), how roles are organized (P4), and what remains invariant across conditions or implementations (P5; illustrated here across random seeds). Measurement choices constrain every inference (P0). A, B, and C denote computational roles. This process supports the discovery of candidate model mechanisms (within-model discovery), which can generate domain hypotheses and establish their plausibility beyond the model requires independent evidence (beyond-model discovery).
blocks.zh: 图1:机械推论的递归逻辑. 对于具有兴趣行为的特定神经系统,可以通过不同的候选研究对象来调查:神经元,特征,电路,人口几何学,和动态学. 我们提出五项原则,以组织机械研究,作为证据为进一步问题和修改先前索赔提供依据的递归过程。 一项单独研究可处理其中的一分问题,并视需要重新审视这些问题。 红箭将这五个暗示问题联系起来:哪个对象解释现象(P1),在计算(P2)时是否使用代表信息(P3),它发挥什么计算作用(P3),角色如何组织(P4),在条件或执行(P5;在此通过随机种子来说明)之间还存在哪些变化. 衡量选择限制每个推论(P0). A、B和C表示计算作用。 这个过程支持了候选模型机制的发现(模型内部的发现),它可以生成域假说并确立其超出模型需要独立证据的可信度(超越模型的发现).

blocks.en: 2 A Brief Tour of Mechanistic Interpretability
blocks.zh: 2 " 机械解释 " 简游

blocks.en: MI refers to a set of techniques for succinctly explaining the behavior of neural networks by reference to their internal representations and computations. These objects of explanation are the ‘mechanisms’. MI approaches differ in what they treat as the object of explanation.
blocks.zh: MI指一套通过参考神经网络的内部表现和计算来简洁地解释神经网络行为的技术. 这些解释的对象都是 " 机制 " 。 多边机构的做法在作为解释对象方面有所不同。

blocks.en: Early work often focused on individual neurons or units. For example, Simonyan et al. (2013) ; Olah et al. (2017) ; Olah et al. (2018) identified units whose activations aligned with human-interpretable visual concepts. Such findings are straightforward; however, neural representations may not always align with individual neurons ( Rigotti et al., 2013 ) . The possibility of distributed representations thus motivated the search for explanatory objects beyond individual neurons ( Morcos et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 早期的工作往往侧重于单个神经元或单位. 例如,Simonyan等人(2013年);Olah等人(2017年);Olah等人(2018年)确定了其活性与人类可解释的视觉概念相一致的单位。 这种发现是直截了当的;然而,神经表达可能并不总是与单个神经元一致(Rigotti等,2013年)。 因此,分布式表达的可能性促使人们寻找单个神经元以外的解释性物体(Morcos等,2018年)。

blocks.en: A newer approach is to recover alternative feature bases. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) learn sparse decompositions of model activations and can identify features that are more interpretable than individual neurons ( Huben et al., 2024 ) . Related approaches identify feature directions that can be intervened to steer model behaviors ( Li et al., 2023 ) . However, such features do not constitute a unique decomposition of model activity ( Leask et al., 2025 ) ; as mechanisms, they are underdetermined.
blocks.zh: 较新的做法是恢复其他特征基础。 Sparse自编码器(SAEs)学习了模型活化的稀疏分解,可以识别比单个神经元更能解释的特征(Huben等,2024). 相关方法确定可以干预的特征方向来引导模型行为(Li等,2023. 然而,这些特征并不构成模型活性的独特分解(Leask等,2025年;作为机制,它们被低估了。

blocks.en: Circuit-level approaches instead ask how multiple components interact to implement a computation. For example, Wang et al. (2023) identified a circuit of interacting attention heads underlying identification of the indirect objects of clauses. More recent work builds circuits over learned sparse features rather than raw model components, illustrating the insights offered by combining feature- and circuit-level descriptions ( Marks et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 电路级方法转而询问多个组件如何相互作用以实施计算. 以王等为例. (2023年)确定了一种相互作用的注意的回路,这是确定条款间接对象的基础。 较近期的工作是利用所学到的稀有特征而不是原始模型组件建立电路,通过结合地物和电路层面的描述来说明所提供的见解(Marks等,2025年)。

blocks.en: One level up in complexity are population-level analyses, which characterize the geometry and low-dimensional structure of activity across many units ( Chung and Abbott, 2021 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Feng and Steinhardt, 2024 ) . For recurrent or temporally extended computation, the relevant mechanism may instead be described as trajectories through a dynamical state space ( Sussillo and Barak, 2013 ) .
blocks.zh: 复杂程度上升的一个层次是人口水平分析,它是许多单位活动几何和低维结构的特点(Chung and Abbott, 2021;Hu等人, 2026;Feng and Steinhardt, 2024)。 对于反复计算或暂时延长的计算,相关机制可被描述为通过动态状态空间的轨迹(Sussillo和Barak,2013年)。

blocks.en: These approaches are not mutually exclusive, but describe neural computation at different scales and in different forms. The growing diversity of explanatory objects raises a more basic question: what does a given result establish about a mechanism, and what remains to be resolved?
blocks.zh: 这些方法并不是相互排斥的,而是描述不同尺度和不同形式的神经计算. 解释性内容日益多样化提出了一个更基本的问题:特定结果对一种机制有什么影响,还有什么有待解决?

blocks.en: 3 Principles for Mechanistic Research
blocks.zh: 3 机械研究原则

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 1 , we organize how the principles below
organize mechanistic research into a recursive logic of inference.
P0 concerns the measurement choices underlying every inference, while
P1 – P5 address distinct gaps between observations and mechanistic claims.
An individual study may address a subset of these gaps, without following
a fixed sequence.
blocks.zh:
如图1所示,我们如何组织下列原则:
组织机械学研究推论的递归逻辑.
P0涉及每个推论所依据的测量选择,而P0则涉及:
P1 — P5处理观察与机械索赔之间的明显差距。
一项单独研究可能涉及这些差距的一分点,而不包括:
一个固定序列。

blocks.en: Principle 0: Mechanistic inference is measurement-dependent.
blocks.zh: 原则0:机械推论依赖测量.

blocks.en: Before any mechanistic inference, researchers should always ask how much of the interpretation depends on how it is measured. This point undergirds all five of the principles below.
blocks.zh: 在任何机械学推论之前,研究者应该总是问解释的多寡取决于如何衡量. 这一点是下面所有五项原则的基础。

blocks.en: Empirical studies have shown that measurement matters. Saliency and feature-visualization methods can produce compelling structure that is only weakly tied to the model computation they are intended to explain ( Adebayo et al., 2018 ; Geirhos et al., 2024 ) . Activation patching can vary with the corruption procedure and evaluation metric ( Zhang and Nanda, 2024 ) . Different measurement choices can yield different views of the same underlying system. As in other sciences, measurements are not neutral – what we observe depends partly on the operations and assumptions we use to make them ( Bechtel, 1988 ; Bridgman, 1927 ) and are therefore part of the evidence for the interpretation.
blocks.zh: 经验研究表明,测量很重要。 显著性和特征可视化方法可以产生令人信服的结构,而这种结构只能与它们打算解释的模型计算弱相接(Adebayo等,2018;Geirhos等,2024)。 激活补丁随腐败程序和评价度量表(张和南达,2024)而变化. 不同的测量选择可以产生对同一基础系统的不同看法. 与其他科学一样,测量不是中性的 — — 我们所观察到的,部分取决于我们用来制造的操作和假设(Bechtel, 1988; Bridgeman, 1927),因此是解释证据的一部分.

blocks.en: Principle 1: Treat the explanatory object as a hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 原则 1: 将解释对象作为假设.

blocks.en: In MI studies, researchers typically start with a privileged explanatory object, such as the single neuron, feature, attention head, or circuit. In practice, however, there is a tendency to assume that the phenomenon of interest is also organized at the level where the method returned promising results, without considering other levels of analysis.
blocks.zh: 在MI研究中,研究者一般从特权解释对象开始,如单神经元,特征,注意力头,或电路. 然而,在实践中,有一种倾向,即认为关注现象也存在于方法返回有希望结果的水平上,而不考虑其他层次的分析。

blocks.en: Evidence from both brains and ANNs shows why this assumption can be misleading. In the prefrontal cortex, task variables remain decodable from population activity even after individually selective neurons are excluded ( Rigotti et al., 2013 ) , indicating that organizational structure can be easily missed at the level of single neurons. A similar pattern appears in ANNs where unit selectivity is sometimes a poor predictor of downstream task performance ( Morcos et al., 2018 ) . Meanwhile, this does not necessarily mean that the single neuron is the wrong object. Bau et al. (2020) , for example, found semantically interpretable units whose causal manipulation affected model behavior. Thus, researchers should treat the explanatory object as an empirical hypothesis, not an a priori assumption.
blocks.zh: 来自大脑和ANNs的证据表明,为什么这种假设可能具有误导性. 在前额皮层中,任务变量即使在排除个别选择性神经元后仍可被人口活动解码(Rigotti等,2013年),表明单个神经元层面的组织结构容易被忽略. 类似模式出现在ANNs中,单位选择性有时是对下游任务性能的预测差(Morcos等,2018年). 同时,这并不一定意味着单神经元是错误的对象. 例如,Bau等人(2020年)发现其因果操纵影响模型行为的可分解单位. 因此,研究者应将解释对象视为经验假设,而不是先验假设.

blocks.en: The choice of explanatory object or level of analysis is constrained in two directions. First, it depends on the phenomena being explained. Researchers should specify the explanandum precisely enough to determine what kind of organization an explanation needs to capture. Second, evidence at adjacent levels can test whether the proposed object is sufficient. For example, when a selective unit is found, one can ask whether the relevant computation remains in the population code; conversely, when a population-level structure is identified, one can ask whether localized circuits or neurons are sufficient to explain the behavior. This need not be an exhaustive search over all possible levels.
blocks.zh: 解释性对象或分析水平的选择在两个方面受到限制。 首先,这取决于所解释的现象。 研究人员应准确具体说明说明,以确定需要说明的组织类型。 第二,相邻水平上的证据可以检验拟议对象是否足够. 例如,当找到一个有选择性的单位时,人们可以问相关的计算是否留在人口代码中;反之,当识别出一个人口层次的结构时,人们可以问局部电路或神经元是否足以解释行为. 这不一定是对所有可能层次的详尽调查。

blocks.en: Principle 2: Distinguish represented from computationally implicated information.
blocks.zh: 原则 2: 与计算所涉信息不同。

blocks.en: Once a candidate representation has been identified, a next step is to ask what information it encapsulates. Here, it is important to distinguish between information that is merely represented (total decodable information) versus information that is used by downstream computations (actual decoded information). Decodability is often used as evidence for the former. However, a variable may be decodable from an internal representation without playing a functional role in producing the behavior ( Diedrichsen and Kriegeskorte, 2017 ; Ritchie et al., 2019 ; Kriegeskorte and Douglas, 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 一旦确定了候选人代表,下一步是询问其中包含哪些信息。 在此,必须区分仅仅代表的信息(总可解码信息)与下游计算使用的信息(实际已解码信息). 解码常被作为前者的证据. 然而,一个变量可能可以从内部代表中解码而无需在生成行为中起功能作用(Diedrichsen and Kriegeskorte,2017;Ritchie等,2019;Kriegeskorte and Douglas,2019).

blocks.en: This distinction has been demonstrated empirically. In human vision, information of visual category can be decoded across broad parts of the visual system, yet only a subset of these representations predicts categorization behavior ( Grootswagers et al., 2018 ) . A similar dissociation appears in ANNs. Models can encode linguistic properties even when those properties are not needed for the task on which the model was trained ( Ravichander et al., 2021 ) , and probing accuracy does not necessarily track the importance of that information for model behavior ( Elazar et al., 2021 ) . Thus, finding that a variable is represented identifies information available in the system, but leaves open whether and where that information enters the computation.
blocks.zh: 这种区别在经验上得到了证明。 在人类视觉中,视觉类的信息可以被解码到视觉系统的广泛部分,然而这些表现中只有子集预言了分类行为(Grootwagers等,2018年). 在ANNs中也出现了类似的脱离. 模型可以编码语言属性,即使模型培训时不需要这些属性(Ravichander等,2021年),而测试准确性不一定跟踪该信息对模型行为的重要性(Elaza等,2021年)。 因此,如果发现一个变量是代表的,则可以确定系统中现有的信息,但该信息是否和在何处进入计算,则不作定论。

blocks.en: The practical upshot is that researchers should explicitly link information identified upstream with downstream states or behavior. Most commonly, one can selectively remove or change the information to see if the downstream computations change as expected.
blocks.zh: 实际结论是,研究人员应将上游发现的信息与下游状态或行为明确联系起来。 最常见的是,人们可以有选择地删除或更改信息,看下游的计算是否如预期的那样发生变化.

blocks.en: Principle 3: Distinguish causal relevance and causal role.
blocks.zh: 原则 3:区分因果关系和因果作用.

blocks.en: Interventions move mechanistic inference from asking whether information is present to asking how the system depends on it. Ablating, patching, or steering a component can establish that changing it affects the behavior of interest. But the same intervention effect may be consistent with different accounts of what that component does.
blocks.zh: 干预将机械推论从询问是否有信息转移到询问系统如何依赖信息. 分解、补丁或引导一个组件可以确定改变它会影响利益行为。 但同样的干预效果可能与对该部分所作所为的不同说法一致.

blocks.en: Neuroscience provides a clear example. In zebra finches, acute silencing of a song region disrupts singing immediately, whereas permanent lesions cause only transient deficits that are then recovered. This is because acute interventions disrupt downstream circuits rather than isolate local function ( Otchy et al., 2015 ; Young et al., 2000 ) . Similarly in ANNs. After attention heads are ablated, downstream components can partially compensate for the perturbation, and the amount of this self-repair varies across inputs ( Rushing and Nanda, 2024 ) . Thus, an observed change after intervention reflects both the targeted component and how the rest of the system responds to the manipulation.
blocks.zh: 神经科学提供了一个明显的例子。 在斑马翅目中,一首歌曲地区的急性静音会立即干扰歌唱,而永久的损伤则只会造成瞬间缺损,然后被恢复. 这是因为尖锐的干预干扰了下游的回路,而不是孤立当地的功能(Otchy等人,2015年;Young等人,2000年)。 同样,在ANNs。 在注意力头被消退后,下游组件可以部分地补偿扰动,这种自修的金额因投入而异(Rushing and Nanda, 2024.). 因此,在干预之后观察到的变化既反映了目标组成部分,也反映了系统其他部分如何应对操纵。

blocks.en: Identifying causal role requires designing interventions that can distinguish between competing explanations of what a component does. Researchers should state the operation a component is hypothesized to perform and derive predictions that follow from that account. For example, under perturbations, one can ask where and when the effect should appear, which downstream quantities should change and how, and which should remain relatively unaffected.
blocks.zh: 确定因果作用需要设计干预措施,以区分对某一组成部分所作所为的不同解释。 研究人员应说明某一组件的假设操作情况并得出该账户的预测。 例如,在扰动下,人们可以问影响应在何地和何时出现,下游哪些数量应该改变,如何改变,哪些数量应该保持相对不受影响。

blocks.en: Principle 4: Distinguish causal roles from mechanistic organization.
blocks.zh: 原则 4:区分机械组织的因果作用.

blocks.en: The next step in elevating components and their causal roles in target computations to the status of ‘mechanism’ is to explore the dependencies among those roles. This step shifts the focus from individual component-role mappings to the relations among them.
blocks.zh: 将组成部分及其在目标计算中的因果作用提升到“机制”地位的下一步是探讨这些作用之间的依赖性。 这一步骤将重点从单个组成部分作用绘图转向它们之间的关系。

blocks.en: Neuroscience provides an example in the case of motor planning in the mouse’s anterior lateral motor cortex (ALM). During a delayed-response task, neurons in both ALM hemispheres exhibit preparatory activity that predicts the upcoming movement. There are three possibilities for such preparatory activity: it depends on local recurrent dynamics within one hemisphere, it is maintained redundantly across the two hemispheres, or the two hemispheres depend on each other. Li et al. (2016) distinguished among them by comparing the results of different perturbations. When one ALM hemisphere was transiently silenced, the population activity was displaced, but after the perturbation ended, the activity pattern rapidly recovered. Meanwhile, bilateral silencing showed that activity did not recover by the end of the delay period. The contrasting outcomes of the two perturbations therefore revealed that the computation was not simply tied to the uninterrupted activity of a particular local population. Rather, these results supported an organization of selectively coupled and partially redundant modules where either hemisphere could maintain the preparatory dynamics, while coupling between them allowed activity in one module to restore the other after a transient perturbation.
blocks.zh: 神经科学为老鼠的后部运动皮层(ALM)的运动规划提供了一个例子. 在一个延迟反应的任务中,两个ALM半球的神经元都显示出预测即将到来的运动的准备活动. 这种筹备活动有三种可能性:它取决于一个半球内当地反复出现的动态,在两个半球之间被冗余地维持,或者两个半球互相依赖. 李等(2016年)通过比较不同扰动的结果而区分了其中. 当一个ALM半球被短暂地沉默后,人口活动被转移,但在扰动结束后,活动模式迅速恢复. 同时,双边沉默表明,在拖延期结束时,活动并未恢复。 因此,两次骚乱的反差结果表明,计算并非仅仅与某一特定当地居民不间断的活动有关。 相反,这些结果支持一个有选择地配有部分多余模块的组织,其中任何一个半球都可以保持筹备动态,而它们之间的结合则允许一个模块的活动在瞬息万变后恢复另一个模块。

blocks.en: This suggests a practical strategy for moving from causal roles to mechanistic organization. Once several components have been assigned candidate roles, researchers can ask what possible dependencies must hold between them. Then, one can perform a series of perturbations on particular inputs, outputs, or paths and measure the intermediate quantities predicted to depend on them.
blocks.zh: 这表明从因果作用转向机械组织的实际战略。 一旦指定了几个组成部分担任候选角色,研究人员可以询问它们之间可能存在的依赖关系。 然后,人们可以对特定投入、产出或路径进行一系列的扰动,并测量预测的依赖它们的中间数量。

blocks.en: Principle 5: Recurse to search for invariants and revisit the explanatory object.
blocks.zh: 原则 5: 重复搜索不变量并重温解释对象.

blocks.en: The organization recovered above provides evidence about the question which began the analysis: whether the original explanatory object was the appropriate level. A level that appeared natural when individual components were first identified might turn out to capture implementation-specific details, but the stable organization might lie elsewhere ( Marr, 1982 ) . For example, circuit-level algorithms remained relatively consistent across training, task, and model scale even when the specific components implementing them change ( Tigges et al., 2024 ; Merullo et al., 2024 ) . Similarly, across independently trained SAEs, individual features may be unstable while the subspaces occupied remain reproducible ( Gerasimov et al., 2026 ) . Thus, an explanation might remain stable and generalize at a higher level of computation while changing at the lower level of individual components.
blocks.zh: 上文中找到的组织提供了开始分析的问题的证据:原始解释性对象是否为适当水平。 在首次确定各个组成部分时看起来自然的级别,可能会成为掌握具体实施细节的阶段,但稳定的组织可能位于其他地方(Marr,1982年)。 例如,电路级算法在整个培训、任务和模型尺度之间保持相对一致,即使执行这些算法的具体组件发生变化(Tigges等,2024;Merullo等,2024)。 同样,在经过独立培训的SAE中,单个特征可能不稳定,而占用的子空间仍然可以复制(Gerasimov等,2026年)。 因此,一种解释在较高水平的计算中可能保持稳定和概括,而在较低层次的单个组成部分中则发生变化。

blocks.en: In practice, a recursive approach can potentially reveal which aspects of a mechanism are stable by testing how its validity changes across conditions. The result might support the original level, require a more abstract description, or reveal that several levels capture different parts of the mechanism. Therefore, the principles are better viewed as recursively applied than as a static checklist.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,通过测试某一机制的有效性如何在各种条件下发生变化,递归式方法有可能揭示该机制的哪些方面是稳定的。 结果可能支持原始层次,需要更抽象的描述,或者揭示几个层次捕捉机制的不同部分. 因此,比起静态核对表,这些原则被更好地视为反复适用。

blocks.en: 4 A Historical Warning: When Interpretable Units Become Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 4 历史警告:当可解释单位成为机制时

blocks.en: A look to the history of neuroscience shows how the distinctions between the five principles emerged.
blocks.zh: 从神经科学的历史来看,这五项原则之间的区别是如何出现的。

blocks.en: Early work asked what a selective neuron (e.g., one responding to an oriented bar or a face) in the brain explained. Gnostic cells and face cells were initially offered as an answer to the question of how objects are represented ( Barlow, 1972 ; Konorski, 1967 ; Gross et al., 1972 ) . The idea of population coding (i.e., distributed representations) shifted the focus from the tuning of individual neurons to the information carried jointly by many cells ( Georgopoulos et al., 1986 ; Haxby et al., 2001 ; Kriegeskorte et al., 2008 ) . Dynamical system accounts ask how population activity evolves over time to explain how the structure of the information within the population is made accessible to downstream neural populations that read that information out to support behavior ( Churchland et al., 2012 ; Mante et al., 2013 ; Sussillo and Barak, 2013 ) . Progress was made as a broad question such as “how does the brain recognize objects” was progressively factored into a set of more precise mechanistic questions: what latent factors are represented, how is information organized, how is it transformed, and how does it ultimately support readout to guide vision-dependent behaviors? Notice that each question admits a different object of description (P1) and its own evidence that the represented information is read out (P2). The notion of ‘causal’ evidence (P3) also went through waves of refinement. Brain lesions, pharmacological inactivations, or microstimulation studies could establish that selective neurons like those for faces were indeed causally involved in face perception behaviors ( Afraz et al., 2006 ; Sadagopan et al., 2017 ; Moeller et al., 2017 ; Parvizi et al., 2012 ) . However, knowing that a region is causally involved still leaves open the questions of what computation it performs and how downstream regions interact to support this behavior (P4). Answering these questions requires explicit models and carefully designed experiments ( Chang and Tsao, 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: 早期的工作询问大脑中选择性神经元(例如,一个响应向上条或脸部)有什么解释. Gnostic细胞和面部细胞最初是作为对物体如何被表示问题的答案(Barlow,1972;Konorski,1967;Gross等,1972.). 人口编码(即分布式表达)的想法将重点从单个神经元的调谐转移到由许多细胞联合携带的信息(Georgopoulos等,1986年;Haxby等,2001年;Kriegeskorte等,2008年). 动态系统账户询问人口活动如何随时间演变,以解释如何让下游读取信息以支持行为的神经人群获取人口信息结构(Churchland等,2012年;Mante等,2013年;Sussillo和Barak,2013年)。 取得了进展,因为“大脑如何识别物体”等广泛问题被逐步纳入一系列更精确的机械问题:潜在因素是什么、信息如何组织、信息如何转化、信息如何最终支持读取以指导依赖视觉的行为? 通知每个问题都承认一个不同的描述对象(P1),并承认其自己关于宣读所代表信息的证据(P2)。 `因果关系 ' 证据的概念(P3)也经历了一波完善。 脑损伤、药理作用不良或微刺激研究可以确定,像面部的选择性神经元确实因果地参与了面部认知行为(Afraz等,2006年;Sadagopan等,2017年;Moeller等,2017年;Parvizi等,2012年)。 然而,如果知道一个区域因果而参与其中,那么它如何进行计算以及下游区域如何相互作用来支持这种行为的问题仍然有待解决(P4)。 回答这些问题需要明确的模型和精心设计的实验(张和曹,2017.

blocks.en: Despite these precedents from neuroscience, interpretability work on convolutional neural network (CNN) models of computer vision has followed a remarkably similar historical path. Early visualization studies revealed a progression from lower-level visual features to more complex patterns across CNN layers ( Zeiler and Fergus, 2014 ) , and individual units within layers were found to detect objects and human-interpretable concepts ( Zhou et al., 2014 ; Bau et al., 2017 ) . But unit interpretability was basis-dependent, and selectivity was later shown to be a poor predictor of task importance ( Morcos et al., 2018 ; Dipani and Ratan Murty, 2026 ) . At the same time, causal interventions demonstrated that some interpretable units do have functional roles ( Bau et al., 2018 ; Bau et al., 2020 ) . Again, selectivity (P1) and causal contribution (P2 and 3) answer different questions, and neither alone determines the full organization of the computation (P4). The shared historical pattern across neuroscience and MI points to a general challenge in mechanistic research. An object revealed by an interpretability method should not automatically be treated as a ‘mechanism’ in the scientific or computational sense. The five principles make explicit the required inferential steps, bridging from what an interpretability method reveals to valid mechanistic claims built on that evidence.
blocks.zh: 尽管神经科学有这些先例,但计算机视觉的进化神经网络(CNN)模型的可解释性工作遵循了非常相近的历史道路. 早期可视化研究揭示出从低等可视化特征跨CNN地层发展到更复杂的模式(Zeiler and Fergus,2014),层内单个单位被发现能检测出物体和人可解释的概念(周等,2014;Bau等,2017). 但单位可解释性依赖依据,选择性后来被证明是任务重要性的差强人意预测(Morcos等,2018;Dipani和Ratan Murty,2026). 同时,因果干预措施表明,一些可解释单位确实具有功能作用(Bau等,2018;Bau等,2020. 同样,选择性(P1)和因果贡献(P2和3)回答了不同的问题,而且两者都不是决定计算(P4)的全面组织。 跨神经科学和MI的共享历史模式指出了机械学研究的普遍挑战. 由可解释性方法揭示的物体不应自动被当作科学或计算意义上的 " 机制 " 。 这五项原则明确了所需的推断步骤,与可解释性方法所揭示的以这些证据为基础的有效的机械性主张相衔接。

blocks.en: 5 What Comes Next: Mechanistic Interpretability as a Science of Discovery
blocks.zh: 5 下一步是什么:作为发现科学的机械解释

blocks.en: MI should be viewed as a science of discovery in two distinct senses.
blocks.zh: MI应被看作是一种从两个不同意义上来说的发现科学.

blocks.en: First, discovering how a neural network represents information, performs computations, and produces behavior itself constitutes scientific discovery. The historical parallel between neuroscience and MI illustrates that progress requires repeatedly refining the explanatory object and the inferences drawn from each class of evidence. Thus, for MI to become a cumulative science of such mechanisms, empirical findings must be connected to mechanistic claims through a shared logic of inference. Our five principles are intended to provide the structure for making such inference validly. They locate what a result establishes, what remains unresolved, and which mechanistic question follows.
blocks.zh: 首先,发现一个神经网络如何代表信息,进行计算,产生行为本身就构成了科学发现. 神经科学与MI之间的历史平行表明,要取得进展,就必须从每一类证据中反复完善解释性对象和推断。 因此,要使MI成为这种机制的累积科学,经验性结论必须通过共同的推论逻辑与机械性主张联系起来。 我们的五项原则旨在为这种推断提供有效结构。 它们找出了结果确定的内容、尚未解决的内容以及随后出现的机械问题。

blocks.en: The second sense of scientific discovery is using models as instruments to learn about domains beyond themselves. In this case, models trained on data from a target domain are then analyzed by MI techniques to extract candidate mechanisms about the external domain ( Simon and Zou, 2025 ) . Here, recovering the computation or mechanism of a model is an intermediate step because a science of model mechanisms is not automatically a science of models of the external world. A mechanism found in the model is, first, a source of hypotheses about that domain. The gap between an MI mechanism and a scientific hypothesis exists because the model might exploit representations or computations that differ from those that generated its training data, so correspondence cannot be assumed. The five principles of our framework also explain what a model mechanism can contribute to scientific discovery beyond the model by turning interpretability results into a precise candidate hypothesis and set of predictions. These predictions can be tested independently of the interpretability analysis and, where possible, independently of the model itself. Behavioral experiments, new datasets, interventions, or domain-specific measurements can determine whether the identified structure reflects the model alone or captures a general regularity of a scientific domain.
blocks.zh: 第二种科学发现感是将模型作为工具来学习超越自身的领域. 在此情况下,由目标域数据培训的模型随后被MI技术分析,以提取关于外部域的候选机制(Simon and Zou, 2025.). 在这里,恢复模型的计算或机制是一个中间步骤,因为模型机制的科学并不是自动的外部世界模型的科学. 在模型中发现的一种机制,首先是关于这个领域的假设的来源. MI机制与科学假设之间的差距之所以存在,是因为模型可能利用与生成其培训数据不同的表达或计算,因此无法假定对应. 我们框架的五项原则还说明,模型机制可以通过将可解释性结果转化为精确的候选假设和一套预测,对模型以外的科学发现作出贡献。 这些预测可以独立于可解释性分析进行测试,并在可能的情况下独立于模型本身. 行为实验,新数据集,干预措施,或特定域的测量,可以确定被识别的结构是单独反映模型,还是捕获一个科学域的一般规律.

blocks.en: In summary, the five principles of our framework guide the potential contributions of MI to scientific discovery along two linked cycles. First, they describe a recursive and rigorous science of mechanisms within models. Second, they serve within a broader scientific cycle in which these mechanisms generate testable hypotheses about the scientific domains the models capture. Although mechanisms found in models can expose candidate explanations, subsequent independent evidence ultimately determines what they reveal beyond the model and of the external world.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们框架的五项原则指导了多边投资机制在两个相互关联的周期内对科学发现的潜在贡献。 首先,它们描述了模型内各种机制的递归和严格的科学。 第二,它们在更广泛的科学周期中发挥作用,在这些周期中,这些机制产生关于模型捕捉的科学领域的可检验假设。 虽然在模型中发现的机制可以暴露候选解释,但随后的独立证据最终决定了它们所揭示的超越模型和外部世界的东西.

blocks.en: 6 Responsible Use
blocks.zh: 6 负责任的使用

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretations may be overgeneralized beyond the evidence supporting them, particularly when model mechanisms are taken to reflect mechanisms in an external scientific domain. We emphasize that model-derived mechanisms should generate testable hypotheses rather than substitute for independent, domain-specific empirical validation.
blocks.zh: 机械解释可能超出支持这种解释的证据的范围,特别是在采用模型机制反映外部科学领域的机制时。 我们强调,模型产生的机制应产生可检验的假设,而不应取而代之的是独立、具体领域的经验验证。
